highlights: Harvest by voice: you can leave off count and grams. Suyo Long, 2, 165, next, in pieces or in one breath, saves 2 count and 165 grams. Before, the second number replaced the first.

The saved line says which unit was guessed. When a number could be part of a plant's name (Cherry Rescue 1, 200) or two numbers seem to have run together, the app says so and saves nothing: say it in parts or with its unit.
When a sentence can't be read, a following next no longer saves the record from before, and a refused next no longer makes the next one say saved once without saving.
